entities.summary: Shmuel Sambursky, or Samuel Sambursky was a German-Israeli physicist, professor, and philosopher. He was a professor of Physics and Natural Sciences and Philosophy of Science at the Hebrew University. He was also a member of the Israel Academy of Sciences and Humanities.
